title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government's response to a 2020 report on artificial intelligence and public standards outlines their plans to address the recommendations made by the committee. The response details the steps the government will take to ensure the responsible development and use of artificial intelligence in the UK.

title: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) in education
description: The Department for Education’s (DfE) position on the use of generative AI in the education sector.
summary: The Department for Education's policy document discusses the use of generative artificial intelligence in education, outlining its position and guidance on the matter. The document aims to provide clarity on the role of generative AI in the education sector, supporting its safe and effective use.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: Ofqual, the regulator of qualifications in the UK, is developing a policy to oversee the use of artificial intelligence in education. The policy aims to address the increasing use of AI in the qualifications sector in response to government requests for guidance.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This document discusses the use of copyrighted materials in the development and creation of artificial intelligence systems. It will assess the potential impacts on copyright holders and the AI industry.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The UK government has released a response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence, acknowledging the importance of addressing the challenges and opportunities presented by AI. The response is in reaction to the committee's report 'AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency', which highlights the need for continued action to ensure the country remains competitive and prepares for the impact of AI.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This document outlines the terms of reference for a committee's review into artificial intelligence and its relationship to public standards. It likely provides guidance on the committee's scope, responsibilities, and key questions to be addressed regarding AI and public standards.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The Centre for Science and Policy (CSPL) has provided written evidence on AI governance to the Science and Technology Committee. The submission likely offers recommendations and insights on how to regulate and manage the development and use of artificial intelligence.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This policy document explores how Artificial Intelligence (AI) affects the regulation of medical products, aiming to implement the guidelines outlined in the AI White Paper. The goal is to adapt current regulations to accommodate the increasingly important role of AI in the development and oversight of medical products.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the defence organisation the world's most effective and efficient use of AI, for its size. The goal is to become a trusted and influential leader in the use of AI.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: This document outlines the Department of Transport's plan to harness the benefits of artificial intelligence in transportation safely and effectively. It aims to balance the opportunities and challenges arising from AI in the transport sector.
